classification: frozen exploratory follow-up pilot plan; recorded before scored model runs

per_run_outcomes.primary: Count of 5 fixed cross-service acceptance checks passed (0-5).
per_run_outcomes.regression: Count of 14 existing cancellation, order-detail, and characterization checks passed (0-14).
per_run_outcomes.combined: Count across all 19 fixed checks (0-19), plus all-checks-passed indicator.
per_run_outcomes.review: Record findings separately; same provider/model is not independent review.

evaluation_procedure: For each proposal, defer code execution in the API-enabled process. Evaluate the saved proposal in a separate restricted local copy, replacing its test tree with the exact pinned tests. Remove OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_MODEL from test subprocesses. The HTTP handler tests use Unix socket pairs; no TCP listener is required. For review-profile runs, send the saved diff and verification record to a separate review call after evaluation.
failure_policy: Record API errors, invalid JSON, timeouts, and test failures as observed; do not silently retry or replace attempts.
interpretation: Exploratory synthetic case study with three repetitions per profile. The task crosses a legacy monolith, database migration, and integrated shipping service; findings remain task-specific and are not powered for broad causal claims.
excluded_runs: Prior cancellation and order-detail cohorts; distinct tasks/revisions.
privacy_and_scope: Only independently created synthetic repository content, requirements, and tests are sent. No employer material or work-factory access is used. Requests set store=false; both repositories remain private.
